spec.name: hook_plate
spec.description: Steel hook plate 120 x 80 x 20 mm (y up), bolted along its top face (y = 80) to a beam, carrying a 1.5 kN hanging load at a lower corner. The brief does not say which lower corner; the x = 120, y = 0 corner is used. With the whole top face clamped, the problem is mirror-symmetric in x, so the other corner gives a mirrored result.

supports.note: Top face (y = 80) bolted to the beam; modelled as fully fixed.

loads.note: 1.5 kN hanging (downward, -y) from the lower corner at x = 120, y = 0. It is spread over an 8 mm x full-thickness patch on the bottom face to avoid a point-load singularity.

passive.note: Solid pad under the load so that the hook point keeps material.

assumptions: The lower corner was taken as x = 120, y = 0. The brief does not specify which corner; the result is symmetric.
The bolted top face was modelled as fully clamped, because no bolt pattern is given.
The load direction was taken as -y, since the load hangs under gravity with y up.
